payload.description: Ask Jev (typesafe.ai's System One model) questions about one state, all in one request. A yesno question, the default, asks how likely the answer is yes; its yes and no are its criteria, and an empty or missing one leaves the criteria out. A pick question asks Jev to pick one of its options; each option's description is its criterion, and an empty or missing one leaves it out. Option names within a question must differ, because Jev knows an option by its name.

state.description: What the questions are about, any JSON object.

id.description: The asker's own id; the answer comes back under it.

options.description: The options of a pick question.

id.description: The asker's own id; the pick comes back under it.

name.description: The option as Jev is offered it.

reply.description: Jev's answers, with the request's input tokens and time; or an error. For a yesno question p is the probability the answer is yes. For a pick question choice is the id of the option Jev picked, p its probability, probabilities the probability of every option, and confidence how sure Jev is, from how the probabilities are spread.

choice.description: For a pick question, the id of the option Jev picked.

probabilities.description: For a pick question, every option's probability, by option id.

confidence.description: For a pick question, how sure Jev is.

starterLeft.description: When the starter key answered, how many starter requests are left.
